Subject: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist

Hi Samir & Lina,

Thanks again for taking the time to meet today - great discussion and appreciated the thoughtful questions on latency and streaming. Per our demo, I captured the high-level performance items we discussed and a short SLO checklist attached (FintechCo_SLO_Checklist.xlsx).

Quick recap / asks so we can move to a benchmark run:
- Target latency: confirm P95 goal and any tail latency constraints (we discussed ~300ms P95 for generation).
- Throughput: estimated sustained requests/sec and expected concurrency (you mentioned a bursty pattern; if you can provide QPS and concurrency that helps).
- Streaming: confirm whether partial streaming of tokens is required for all endpoints and any client timeouts.
- Model preferences: any guardrails on model size/quantization or must be open-model only?

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) You confirm SLO targets (latency/throughput/streaming) - reply with numbers.
2) Rishi will produce a load test plan & benchmark config.
3) We schedule a 2-hr benchmark window (we can run as a hosted proof-of-performance or schedule Dedicated nodes).
4) Procurement and legal get draft MAP (we can share Doc with milestones).

I've cc'd Rishi from our SE team to draft the load test plan and make sure we have the right metrics.

Attachments: FintechCo_SLO_Checklist.xlsx (SLO fields + decision criteria matrix)

Thanks - happy to jump on another call if useful.


Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: FintechCo - Post-demo performance recap & SLO checklist

Marissa - thanks for the recap and the checklist. Couple of clarifications from our side:

- Latency: Our internal product target is P95 < 300ms for the generate endpoint (99th percentile should be < 700ms during normal load). For retrieval calls we expect P95 < 150ms.
- Throughput / Concurrency: Typical steady-state is ~200 rps with bursts to 600 rps during peak events. Concurrency per instance we'd expect to see around 40-60 concurrent streams.
- Streaming: Yes - streaming partial responses is required for the user-facing flows (we rely on partial tokens for progressive UI updates). Client-side timeout is 8s.
- Security / Model: We prefer using smaller quantized open models (cost consideration) as long as quality meets our accuracy threshold.

Next steps from our side: procurement wants a high-level MAP and a proposed pilot timeline. Can Rishi share a load test plan and proposed measurement rubric? Also include any assumptions about warm-up and KV cache priming.

Samir
Samir Shah

Hi Samir - great notes. I put together a draft LoadTestPlan_v1.pdf (attached) and a short technical summary here.

Assumptions / technical approach:
- Target endpoints: generation (streaming) and retrieval (non-streaming). We'll test both.
- Models: start with redwood-7b-q4 (quantized) for cost baseline, then run head-to-head with a full fp16 13B variant if accuracy misses threshold.
- Latency metrics: measure P50/P95/P99 for token-level streaming and end-of-response completion. We'll also capture serialization time on the client side.
- Throughput testing: ramp to steady-state 250 rps, then burst tests to 600 rps to observe tail behavior.
- Concurrency: run 50 concurrent sessions that stream tokens; measure per-session tail and server-side CPU/GPU utilization.
- Warm-up / KV cache: we'll include a 15-minute warm-up to populate KV caches and a second warm-up with realistic prefix caching. Live sessions will simulate the user mix you described.

Deliverables:
- LoadTestPlan_v1.pdf (attached) - test harness, metrics, and scripts
- Benchmark report after run with per-route dashboards + token-level cost estimates
- Recommended config: batching window = 40ms, dynamic batching cap = 128 tokens, quantization profile for redwood-7b-q4.

Proposed window: Tue 23 Apr 2028, 10:00-12:00 PT (we can do a hosted run or spin Dedicated nodes for a controlled test). If that works, I'll provision and share the run instructions.


Rishi Malhotra

- Milestone 2 (Pilot review): Review accuracy + cost; if accuracy < threshold we run 13B variant.
- Milestone 3 (Procurement): Procurement & legal sign-off on pilot terms; target procurement decision by 05/10/2028.

Proposed meeting slot for the benchmark run: Tue 23 Apr 2028, 10:00-12:00 PT. Please confirm and let us know whether you prefer Hosted API run or Dedicated nodes (we recommend Dedicated for tighter tail latency isolation).
